patent-fetched.eventDescription: One US patent publication delivered as a structured record: publication number and kind code, title, whether the publication is a grant or an application publication, the recorded assignee (or the applicant where no assignee is recorded) and first-listed inventor exactly as published in the official register, filing / publication / priority dates, application number, CPC classifications, USPTO's family ID and a link to the official USPTO PDF of the publication. Already-seen patents, out-of-window results, silently seeded patents (monitorOnlyNew), ERROR records and the run SUMMARY are never charged.
